design.navigation: Dashboard card to a fresh editor, local packaged assets and offline project replay, 19281 stored objects, initial arena contains six artboards. External business images are placeholders. Unthrottled Electron main process; renderer and iframe targets set to 1x or 4x using CDP.
design.A: Existing HostFrameViewInitializer loader requests and evaluates Studio.
design.B: In Host Root.loader immediately after loadProjectEntry(), start the same Promise.all of 44 Rspack ensure calls; preserve the original require(818378) at the normal import site. Uses the same private instrumented release renderer as A. The removedRefActions early return is enabled in both.
design.warmup: Two independent ten-open batches per CPU setting; first two per batch excluded; within each later pair, arm order alternates across pairs.
design.businessPixels: First capturePage sample matching at least 37/40 reference pixels in the Home artboard. Sampling and readback add uncertainty.
design.savings: A minus B within each adjacent pair; positive is faster with preload. Per-arm medians and paired savings medians are computed separately.

diagnostics4x.method: Three additional 4x baseline opens timed on each uncached module factory during the original synchronous require tree; self time subtracts child factories. A separate single 4x baseline open records Chromium tracing and V8 CPU samples. These diagnostic runs are excluded from A/B timings. Chunk sums and traced timeline event families may use different instruments; timeline names can nest. A source at entry identifies a generated factory, which can contain several concatenated source modules.

firstEvaluationPaths.observedModule: factory containing emoji-picker-react and flairup styles

diagnostics4x.attribution: First-visit inclusive times include uncached child factories and can move when import order changes. Nested rows are not additive. Labels verified against release factory exports, code signatures and repository imports. Named third-party factories were also checked against local source maps where emitted code matched.

trace.scope: One independent A run with Chromium tracing and V8 profiling. Durations inflated by instrumentation. Sample time under the Rspack runtime includes work V8 attributed to its require/call boundary. Nested timeline event families overlap.

methodNotes: The released dependency group includes 44 JS and 14 CSS files. Both arms observed all 58 unique URLs in every measured Host; package byte counts are uncompressed disk sizes.

The host-to-normal-import interval includes work before the original loader gets control. Chunk readiness includes downloaded script registration and stylesheet handling. Response-end is not a measure of pure network time.

Both arms opened Home by clicking the dashboard card. Between runs the harness returned via StudioWindow.loadURL to its retained dashboard. All four complete timing batches had zero renderer errors. Incomplete setup pilots were excluded.
The preload experiment was applied only to a private release renderer. Product routing and module timing are unchanged in the repository.
